solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, number freed: 6 across to 5); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Kind actors playing similar roles continually

parts.note: a kind is a type or sort
the actors in a production are its cast

explanation.surface: A description of a certain sort of performer who keeps getting the same part.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who is always given the same sort of part has been pigeonholed by casting directors.

clue.text: Joint best team

parts.note: the best is the top
a team is a side

explanation.surface: Two players share first place in a league.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joint' looks like 'shared'; it is a cut of meat: topside is a lean cut of beef from the hindquarter, a British roasting joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut of beef for roasting is a joint in British butchery.

clue.text: Spread glue

explanation.surface: An instruction to smear adhesive.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft savoury sandwich filling and a wallpaper adhesive share this word.

clue.text: Chapter on poor reorganisation helping large firm

indicators.note: in a down clue the chapter letter sits on top of what follows
the letters of the word poor are rearranged

parts.note: a helping is a ration or portion

explanation.surface: A book chapter about a botched restructuring that helps a big company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reorganisation' turns POOR into ORPO; 'reorganisation' looks like the definition but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A big incorporated business company is a legal entity of this kind.

clue.text: Quiet and enthusiastic about religion

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
being into something means being keen on it

explanation.surface: Someone is calm but passionate about faith.
explanation.definitionFit: The native faith of Japan, centred on the worship of spirits called kami.

clue.text: Girl in film is seductive

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the phrase that follows, spanning its words

explanation.surface: A young woman on screen is alluring.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl or unmarried young woman is addressed by this title, so it stands for her.

clue.text: Base of British Legion damage externally

indicators.note: the jumbled word goes outside the British letter
damaging the word Legion jumbles its letters

explanation.surface: The foundation of a veterans' charity is harmed from outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damage' turns LEGION into IGNOLE, which 'externally' puts around B. The British Legion is the UK's armed-forces veterans' charity.
explanation.definitionFit: Base in the moral sense means low, dishonourable and contemptible.

clue.text: Guide soothsayer round Petra's centre

indicators.note: the prophet's letters go round the picked letter

parts.note: a soothsayer is a seer

indicators.note: the middle letter of the name Petra

explanation.surface: Someone leads a fortune-teller around the middle of the ancient Jordanian city.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide a vehicle or a person is to direct their course.

clue.text: Model's difficult question

definitions.meaning: an artist's model is someone who sits or stands for a picture
a puzzle or tricky problem put to someone

explanation.surface: A fashion model's tricky problem.
explanation.definitionFit: A model strikes attitudes for the camera, and a thorny problem set to someone is also called by this word.

clue.text: Anger shown by home clubs seen off

parts.note: someone at home is said to be in
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

indicators.note: off here means gone wrong, so the word seen is jumbled

explanation.surface: Fury when the home side's teams are sent away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Anger' reads as a noun in the surface but works as a verb here; 'off' is the anagram signal, not a sign of removal.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrage someone is to make them furious, a verb sense quite separate from the fragrant smoke.

clue.text: Forged bar — it must contain iron

indicators.note: the bar word and it together hold the iron symbol

parts.note: a bar in a pub or shop is a counter
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A blacksmith's rule that a forged bar needs iron in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forged' looks like metalwork, matching bar and iron; it means faked.
explanation.definitionFit: Forged in the sense of faked, like a fraudulent banknote.

clue.text: Diamonds leader lost in French resort

indicators.note: the leading letter of the resort's name is dropped

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: Jewels go missing from someone at a Riviera holiday town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader lost' removes the N from NICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for diamonds or other jewels, as in a gangster film's 'the rocks'.

clue.text: Have more than revealed by issue

parts.note: something revealed is out in the open
an issue of a magazine is a number

explanation.surface: Something has more than was disclosed in a publication.
explanation.definitionFit: To exceed in quantity is to be greater in count than the other side.

clue.text: Unusually small bit players

parts.note: extra can mean unusually, as in extra careful
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Actors with minor parts who are strangely little.
explanation.definitionFit: Film walk-on performers with no lines are background people in crowd scenes.

clue.text: Turtle avoiding soft ground

indicators.note: the reptile word steers clear of the soft letter, which drops out

parts.note: a terrapin is a small freshwater turtle
p, piano, is the musical abbreviation for soft

explanation.surface: A turtle keeps off marshy ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Land considered for its physical features is the lie of the ground.

clue.text: Visit nurse after a short time

indicators.note: the caring word comes after the first two pieces

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to nurse is to tend

explanation.surface: A carer calls round after a brief interval.
explanation.definitionFit: To go to an event or place, such as a school or a meeting, is to be present there.

clue.text: Follows sailor's night light

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them
tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman tracks a light in the dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Sirius, the brightest star in the sky at night, has this canine nickname.

clue.text: Celebrity on church formality

indicators.note: in a down clue the celebrity sits on top of the church

parts.note: a celebrity is a star

explanation.surface: A famous person attends a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiffness of manner, a figurative use of the stuff that stiffens collars.

clue.text: Advocate increase, mostly to disrupt trade

indicators.note: the shortened word breaks into the trading word

parts.note: to trade is to barter

indicators.note: most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: an increase is a rise

explanation.surface: Someone urges a price hike designed to upset commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advocate' looks like a verb going with 'increase', but it is the noun: in Britain an advocate who pleads in the higher courts.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtroom lawyer who argues cases is an advocate, especially in Britain.

clue.text: The fundamental ingredient of book without any changes

parts.note: as is means unaltered, as in sold as is

explanation.surface: The key part of a book is left untouched.
explanation.definitionFit: The foundation or main underlying element of something.

clue.text: Important American soldier returned after onset of battle

indicators.note: the reversed soldier comes after that letter
the start of the word battle gives its first letter
the soldier's letters are read back to front

parts.note: GI is the usual name for an American soldier

explanation.surface: A key US serviceman comes home after a battle begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Something significant or major is a large matter, as in 'a big decision'.

clue.text: Head of bank, reckless and cocky

indicators.note: the head of the word bank is its first letter

parts.note: rash means reckless

explanation.surface: A bank chief is foolhardy and arrogant.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-assertive and overconfident in a loud, pushy way.

clue.text: Hand tool, last of his I removed from bag

indicators.note: the final letter of the word his
the letter is taken out of the bag word

parts.note: a pannier is a bag hung on a bicycle or a horse

explanation.surface: Someone takes a tool of his out of a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed from' takes the I out of PANNIER, leaving PANNER.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrench for turning nuts is a hand-held tool; the British name is the usual one.

clue.text: Former deed, correct in every detail

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
a deed is an act

explanation.surface: An old legal document is perfectly accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: Precise and accurate down to the last particular.

clue.text: Son with contents of hourglass?

parts.note: with and and both join one thing to another

explanation.surface: A boy has what is inside an egg timer.
explanation.definitionFit: An hourglass measures time by fine grains trickling through, the question mark marking an example.

clue.text: Not this dear French stateswoman

parts.note: the alternative to this is that
cher is the French for dear

explanation.surface: Someone picks one French darling over another.
explanation.walkthrough: Margaret Thatcher was Britain's Prime Minister from 1979 to 1990.
explanation.definitionFit: The first female British Prime Minister is a famous political leader.
